anomalies.observed: U19 pin 4 (GND1) and pin 5 (GND2) are both connected to the GND net. The same is true for U23 pins 4 and 5.
anomalies.expected: For an isolated CAN transceiver, GND1 (logic side) and GND2 (bus side) must be on separate isolated grounds, not tied together.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: Galvanic isolation is defeated, creating a ground loop and potential damage; the CAN buses are no longer isolated.

anomalies.observed: J8 (CAN Interface A) and J34 (CAN Interface B) both connect to the same CANH/CANL nets for both U19 and U23. For example, J8 pin 8 and J34 pin 8 are both on /NET0016 (U19 CANL); J8 pin 5 and J34 pin 5 are both on /NET0201 (U19 CANH); J8 pin 3 and J34 pin 3 are both on /NET0141 (U23 CANL); J8 pin 2 and J34 pin 2 are both on /NET0192 (U23 CANH).
anomalies.expected: Each M12 connector should carry only its own CAN bus (CAN Interface A for one bus, CAN Interface B for the other), as per the specification.

evidence.quote: broken out on M12 circular connectors J2 ("CAN Interface A") and J13 ("CAN Interface B")

anomalies.impact: The two CAN buses are both present on both connectors, so they are not separate interfaces; connecting devices to both connectors can short the two buses together or cause bus contention.

anomalies.observed: The netlist contains no component with value or MPN PCF85063ATAAZ, and no RTC-related nets or components.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the board implements an RTC (PCF85063ATAAZ).

evidence.quote: an RTC (datasheet link in cm4_robot_board/docs points to a PCF85063ATAAZ RTC — see new_notes.txt)

anomalies.impact: No real-time clock functionality; timekeeping is lost on power cycle.
